content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing required prior authorization, and Silverbridge does not allow retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer review. Although similar necessity appeals have not succeeded, a formal appeal is the only available payer-compliant action that can still challenge the denial; resubmission would not correct the authorization defect, and billing the patient for the full balance would be premature.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
